impressum.title: Legal Notice
impressum.name: Provider
impressum.natureText: This website is a private, non-commercial project. It carries no advertising, pursues no commercial purpose and generates no revenue. It is therefore not a business telemedia service within the meaning of § 5 of the German Digital Services Act (DDG), which is why no postal address is given here. Enquiries reach me reliably at the email address above.
impressum.disclaimerText: No warranty is given for the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of the information provided. The menu data is collected automatically from the publicly accessible pages of Studierendenwerk Göttingen and may be incomplete or out of date; the notice posted on site is always authoritative. All information without warranty.
impressum.linksText: This website links to external sites whose content is outside my control. The respective provider is always responsible for such third-party content. No legal violations were apparent at the time of linking. Should I become aware of any violation, I will remove the link concerned without delay.
impressum.userContentText: Ratings, reviews and photos are created by visitors. They express those visitors’ personal opinions and are not statements by the site operator. Anyone uploading a photo thereby confirms that they hold the necessary rights to it. I remove unlawful content once I become aware of it — please send reports to the email address above.
impressum.affiliationText: This is an independent private project with no connection to Studierendenwerk Göttingen, the University of Göttingen or HAWK. The menu data comes from the publicly accessible pages of Studierendenwerk Göttingen. The names and marks of these institutions are used for descriptive purposes only.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: This website is a private, non-commercial project. It runs without advertising, tracking or analytics services. What follows describes the data that nevertheless arises, what it is used for, and what rights you have.
datenschutz.controllerText: The controller responsible for processing personal data on this website is:
datenschutz.hostingText: The site runs on a virtual server operated by Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) in Göttingen, Germany. GWDG runs the infrastructure and has technical access to the server. The data stays in Germany; there is no transfer to third countries.
datenschutz.logsText: When you visit the site, the web server automatically records:
datenschutz.logsTime: the date and time of the request
datenschutz.logsRequest: the address requested, with method and protocol
datenschutz.logsStatus: the HTTP status code and the amount of data transferred
datenschutz.logsAgent: your browser and operating system identification (user agent)
datenschutz.logsPurpose: This data is technically necessary to deliver the site, detect faults and prevent abuse. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure operation). It is not combined with other data and not evaluated for advertising purposes.
datenschutz.logsRetention: The logs are held in a rotating buffer of at most 5 × 10 MB: once it is full, the oldest entries are overwritten by newer ones. There is therefore no fixed retention period in days — how far back the buffer reaches depends on traffic.
datenschutz.storageText: This website sets no cookies. Instead, a few values are kept in your browser’s local storage. These values leave your device only where explicitly stated below:
datenschutz.storageToken: mensa_token — your session key. It exists only while you are signed in and is deleted when you sign out.
datenschutz.storageTheme: mensa_theme — your choice of light or dark appearance. Purely local, with no relation to your person.
datenschutz.storageVoter: mensa_voter_id — a random identifier used to count each of your up- and downvotes on reviews and photos only once. It is created as soon as you first expand a dish, is sent to the server and stored there alongside your votes. It contains no name, but it is persistent: votes from the same browser can be linked to one another, and to your account if you were signed in when you voted.
datenschutz.storageDelete: You can delete these values at any time by clearing this site’s data in your browser. Your vote counting then starts afresh.
datenschutz.accountText: An account is optional — rating works without signing in. If you register, the following is stored: your username, an optional display name, a hash of your password (scrypt — the password itself is not stored) and the time of registration. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (provision of the account).
datenschutz.accountNoEmail: No email address is collected, deliberately. This also means a forgotten password cannot be reset, and I have no way to contact you on my own initiative.
datenschutz.accountSession: When you sign in, a session key is stored on the server. It does not expire automatically; it is deleted when you sign out. Deleting your account ends all sessions.
datenschutz.contentText: Star ratings, reviews and photos are public and visible to everyone without signing in. What gets published is the rating value, the review text, any photo, the time of the post (to the second) and an author name.
datenschutz.contentAnon: If you are signed in, the author name is your username or your display name. Without signing in, the server generates a fresh random pseudonym for each post, so separate anonymous posts cannot be linked through the name.
datenschutz.contentPhotos: Uploaded photos are stored on the same server and served without authentication at their own address. Browsers and intermediate caches may keep them for up to 30 days, so a deleted photo may briefly still appear from a cache.
datenschutz.contentExif: Metadata in image files (EXIF/XMP) — such as device model, capture time or GPS coordinates — is removed on the server before the file is stored. The original file name is not kept either.
datenschutz.votesText: For each up- or downvote the following is stored: the review concerned, the direction of the vote, the time, the mensa_voter_id identifier described above and — if you were signed in — your account. The sole purpose is to prevent repeat voting and to determine the representative photo for a dish (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
datenschutz.externalText: The small icons for labels such as “vegan” or “vegetarian” are loaded directly from the servers of Studierendenwerk Göttingen. In doing so, that provider learns your IP address, your browser identification and the address of this website; this is outside my control. No other external content is embedded: no web fonts, no CDNs, no analytics or error-reporting services.
datenschutz.retentionText: Your account, ratings, reviews, photos and votes are kept until you delete them or delete your account; there is no automatic deletion schedule. The database and the photos are backed up nightly. Deleted content may still be contained in those backups for up to 14 days (daily backups) and, if it was present on a Sunday, for up to 56 days (weekly copies). After that the backups are overwritten.
datenschutz.rightsText: You have the right at any time to:
datenschutz.rightsAccess: access the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR)
datenschutz.rightsObject: object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR)
datenschutz.rightsSelf: Two things you can do directly yourself: edit or delete individual ratings, including their photo, in the “Account” area, and delete your account entirely from the same place. Deleting the account removes your username, password hash and all sessions; your ratings remain as anonymous posts under a random pseudonym and can no longer be attributed to you. If you would like the posts themselves gone as well, an email is enough.
datenschutz.rightsHow: For everything else — access, a copy of your data, rectification, restriction, objection — an email to the address above is sufficient. Since no email address is stored with an account, I can only act on a request if the link to the account can be established beyond doubt; I will agree the procedure with you by email.
datenschutz.rightsCaveatName: Two limitations, for the sake of honesty: changing your display name applies only to future posts — already published ratings keep the name used at the time. I am happy to adjust it manually on request.
datenschutz.rightsCaveatSides: Ratings of side dishes cannot currently be edited or deleted by you. Please use the email address above for those.
datenschutz.complaintText: If you believe that the processing of your data infringes data protection law, you may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The competent authority is: Die Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz Niedersachsen, Prinzenstraße 5, 30159 Hannover, Germany.
datenschutz.noneText: No advertising, no tracking, no audience measurement, no cookies, no profiling, no automated decision-making within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR, no sharing or sale of data to third parties, and no transfer to countries outside the EU.

auth.rules: 3-30 characters (letters, digits, _ or -). Password at least 8 characters.
auth.noFavourites: No favourites yet. Rate a dish 4 or 5 stars.
auth.displayNameLong: Display name must be at most 30 characters
auth.displayNameInvalid: Display name must contain only letters, digits, spaces, underscore, or hyphen
auth.confirmDeleteAccount: Really delete your account? Your username and password will be removed and all sessions ended. Your ratings will remain as anonymous posts. This cannot be undone.

auth.deleteRatingFailed: The review could not be deleted.
